sourceSteps: 坐在地板上，双腿伸到身前。
将双手放在臀部旁边的地板上，手指指向前方。
启动你的核心并将双腿抬离地面，保持伸直。
尝试使双腿与地面平行，与身体形成“L”形。
尽可能长时间地保持这个姿势。
慢慢地将双腿放回起始位置。
sourceImageLicense: Original Zeno artwork; no upstream exercise media used.
reviewObservation: Upright torso and both straight horizontal legs form clear L. Both palms planted beside hips with straight elbows, pelvis and feet show floor gap; tail relaxed behind to side rather than propping torso.
